cards.answer: Gangplank is a fighter who uses targeted pistol shots and chained barrel explosions to fight at range. His damage favors AD, with physical damage from shots and barrels, true damage from his melee burn, and magic damage from his barrage.
cards.counterplay: Keep clear of connected barrels, contest them when safe, and pressure him after his cleanse is spent.

cards.answer: Parrrley is a targeted pistol shot that deals physical damage, applies on-hit effects, and can critically strike. It can detonate barrels; kills from the shot or its barrel explosions grant gold and Silver Serpents, which fund ultimate upgrades.
cards.counterplay: Respect his targeted poke range and avoid standing near barrels he can shoot.

cards.answer: Powder Keg places barrels whose health decays toward destruction range. Enemies can attack them to safely defuse them; if Gangplank destroys a barrel with an attack or Q, it explodes and detonates connected barrels. Explosions spread the triggering attack's damage, slow enemies, ignore part of their armor, and add physical damage against champions; critical strikes can amplify the explosion.
cards.counterplay: Move away from connected barrels or contest the finishing attack when safe; watch for chains extending toward you.

cards.answer: Cannon Barrage targets an area globally, repeatedly dealing magic damage, slowing enemies, and revealing the area. Purchased upgrades can add a central true-damage impact with a stronger slow, increase the bombardment, or grant movement speed to Gangplank and allies inside.
cards.counterplay: Leave the bombardment area promptly and avoid lingering in its center.
